source.name: NMRA S-9.2.2 Draft - Configuration Variables for Digital Command Control

notes: This database describes standard/common NMRA CV meanings.
Decoder manufacturers may add manufacturer-specific CVs and restrictions. Always check the decoder manual before writing an unfamiliar CV.

1.name: Primary address
1.description: Short locomotive address used when CV29 bit 5 is off.

2.name: Vstart
2.description: Motor drive level at the first speed step.

3.name: Acceleration rate
3.description: Acceleration momentum. Value 0 disables programmed acceleration delay.

4.name: Deceleration rate
4.description: Braking/deceleration momentum. Value 0 disables programmed braking delay.

5.name: Vhigh
5.description: Motor drive level at the maximum speed step. Values 0 or 1 mean Vhigh is not used.

6.name: Vmid
6.description: Motor drive level near the middle speed step. Values 0 or 1 mean Vmid is not used.

7.name: Manufacturer version
7.description: Decoder version value assigned by the manufacturer.
7.warning: Some standards/manufacturers define special actions when this CV is written.

8.name: Manufacturer ID
8.warning: Writing CV8 is commonly used by decoders for reset or other manufacturer-defined actions.

15.name: Decoder lock select
15.description: Selects which decoder may accept writes when decoder locking is used.

16.name: Decoder lock ID
16.description: Decoder lock identity. Value 0 disables decoder locking.

17.name: Extended address high byte
17.description: High byte of the extended locomotive address.

18.name: Extended address low byte
18.description: Low byte of the extended locomotive address.

19.name: Consist address
19.description: Consist address and relative direction information.

21.name: Consist functions F1-F8
21.description: Bits 0-7 select whether F1-F8 also respond to the consist address.

22.name: Consist functions FL/F9-F12
22.description: Selects whether lighting and F9-F12 also respond to the consist address.

bits.name: Speed/function packet mode
bits.off: 14-step style; F0 carried in speed command
bits.on: 28-step style; F0 carried in function command

31.name: Index high byte
31.description: High byte used for indexed CV page selection.

32.name: Index low byte
32.description: Low byte used for indexed CV page selection.

65.name: Kick start
65.description: Extra motor drive applied when starting from stop.

66.name: Forward trim
66.description: Forward motor-voltage scale factor; interpreted relative to 128.

67-94.name: Extended speed table
67-94.description: Twenty-eight speed-table entries used when CV29 bit 4 is on.

95.name: Reverse trim
95.description: Reverse motor-voltage scale factor; interpreted relative to 128.
